No sourceRoot for relative path rows can yield missingSourceInput unless the needed file exists at fallback path. Python exceptions for malformed input can fail directly.

Base Python build manifest supplies kind,repoId,repoClass,projectionMode,status,nonAuthority, sourceRefs/inputLockDigest/packetFiles but NOT sourceDigests[],packageUniverseDigest or eight contract-named packet component digests (packagesDigest/assertionsDigest/receiptsDigest/readmeProjectionDigest/providerCiDigest/findingsDigest/admissionDigest), so the mandated digest coverage is absent. Existing inputLockDigest/outputDigest in producer-provenance.json are distinct hashes, not silently equivalent. ADRS govPackageRow.v1 demands kind/repoId/packageId/packagePath/packageClass/purposeRef/contractRefs[]/assertionRefs[]/receiptRefs[]/readmeProjectionRef/status; Python producer copies caller-provided row JSONL without shape validation, so exact row completeness is caller-dependent, not established here.
